description: '''Pigfuck''' is a [[subgenre]] of [[noise rock]], originally coined as "pigfucker" by music journalist [[Robert Christgau]] in a 1987 [[Pazz & Jop]] essay in [[The Village Voice|''the Village Voice'']] to describe the music of [[Sonic Youth]] and [[Big Black]]. The label later became associated with the sounds of American [[post-hardcore]] and noise rock groups like Big Black, [[Butthole Surfers]], [[Cows (band)|Cows]], [[Scratch Acid]], [[Killdozer (band)|Killdozer]], [[Pussy Galore (band)|Pussy Galore]], [[the Jesus Lizard]] and [[Flipper (band)|Flipper]] along with artists associated with the independent record labels [[Touch and Go Records|Touch and Go]] and [[Amphetamine Reptile Records|Amphetamine Reptile]].
